brand_identity.visual_mood: Minimal, lots of whitespace, crisp, clean desk environments, serious study focus.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-primary
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-primary

rules: Headings (H1/H2) must use tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`).
Never center text by default; define explicit alignment and hierarchy. Left-align dense content and paragraphs.
Never use Inter for headings. Use Outfit for a premium Apple/Stripe look.
Ensure hierarchy gap rule: jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Use primary (#0B1F3A) for main headings and critical emphasis.
Use accent (#2563EB) strictly for CTAs, active states, and primary buttons. Limit its use.
No generic full-screen gradients. Use subtle lighting or clean solid backgrounds (#F8FAFC).
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
Tint neutral greys with a tiny bit of blue (cool) to match the brand.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Focus on negative space to create a premium feel.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: The 'Tetris' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Prioritize asymmetry.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize all pixels.
rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
Mobile-first responsive. Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat background (surface #FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#E2E8F0), no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-lg).
surfaces_and_components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/40). Never use fully transparent.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Crisp edges, moderate radii (rounded-md or rounded-lg). High contrast text on hover. e.g. hover:bg-accent-hover hover:text-white.
surfaces_and_components.borders: Nested radii (child <= parent). Crisp edges via semi-transparent borders.
shadcn_rules: Use Shadcn UI for dashboard, forms, tables, dialogs, and interactive logic.
Use raw HTML + Tailwind for marketing page structures to maintain creative freedom.
Customize Shadcn components to remove the 'default Vercel' look and match the premium academic brand.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent/50.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties for transitions, not 'all' (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle scale on hover for cards. Smooth entrances for list items.

rules: Hero image overlay max opacity: bg-black/50 or bg-white/40. If image isn't visible, overlay is too heavy.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this file entirely before beginning implementation.
Ensure Tailwind config is updated with the exact colors provided.
Install and configure 'Outfit' for headings and 'Inter' for body.
Implement the Apple/Stripe aesthetic: generous padding, clean 1px borders, white surfaces on light gray backgrounds.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the landing page to ensure layout flexibility and use Shadcn exclusively for complex interactive components (forms, dashboard tables, dropdowns).
Apply `data-testid` consistently across all interactive elements.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Strict enforcement.
Incorporate the media URLs provided instead of placeholders.
